prompt: Make a 20-second 16:9 motion graphics video that tells a little story with sound. For the first 12 seconds there is no sound at all: on a warm paper background, the words "make it catchy." type themselves out, then the letters fall apart and build a colorful music machine piece by piece: ramps, spinning gears, a row of blocks like piano keys and a big drum. It ends with a ball waiting at the top. At 12 seconds the ball drops and the machine comes alive. Every block it hits plays a note, the drum kicks, the gears tick in rhythm, and it all becomes a catchy 4-second beat. Then everything snaps into the words "ONE PROMPT" on a final hit, followed by silence. Use bold geometric shapes in ink black, cobalt blue and sunflower yellow, and make every sound match a movement you can see. Go all out and render the final MP4.

post.originalText:
One prompt. Claude Opus 5.5 made this whole clip: the animation, the typography and the music.

And it didn't stop there.

Claude also edited the final video from my raw recording: the cuts, the captions, the layout and the sound mix. All I did was record myself, give Claude the raw video and write a normal prompt.

For the clip itself, there was no stock music and no sound effects library.
Claude wrote every sound and synced each one to a movement on screen.

It took about 30 minutes from prompt to finished clip.

A year ago this was a job for a motion designer, an animator, a sound designer and an editor. Now it's a first draft you can get by working with claude.

Here is the exact prompt I used for the clip:

"Make a 20-second 16:9 motion graphics video that tells a little story with sound. For the first 12 seconds there is no sound at all: on a warm paper background, the words "make it catchy." type themselves out, then the letters fall apart and build a colorful music machine piece by piece: ramps, spinning gears, a row of blocks like piano keys and a big drum. It ends with a ball waiting at the top. At 12 seconds the ball drops and the machine comes alive. Every block it hits plays a note, the drum kicks, the gears tick in rhythm, and it all becomes a catchy 4-second beat. Then everything snaps into the words "ONE PROMPT" on a final hit, followed by silence. Use bold geometric shapes in ink black, cobalt blue and sunflower yellow, and make every sound match a movement you can see. Go all out and render the final MP4."

What would you use this for in your work?
